# Gate Macs that carry their own runner label `carrick-signed-gate-<runner name>` (#2335), one runner name
# per line, exactly as the runner registered (`RUNNER_NAME`). `signed-gate route` sends a gate to a Mac only
# when its name is listed here, so a typo or a retired Mac can never strand a job on a label nobody serves:
# it falls back to the shared `carrick-signed-gate` label every gate Mac also keeps.
carrick-m4
cloudmac-gate
